items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: My John mother had once taken me to hear Marion Anderson... I don't think we could. She was just such a serious singer, you know. She was in a whole different thing.

ctx.x: Yes, I remember it very well. It was a great concert, and that was my first time at Carnegie Hall onstage. My John mother had once taken me to hear Marion Anderson, which is something I will never forget.
